title: The alternating-series lower bracket, closed against the actual limit
statement: For a nonnegative, non-increasing sequence a, if the alternating partial sums sumRange t converge to a limit L, then for every m, the even-count partial sum E(m) is <= L. This is CReal.alternatingBracket's per-index bracket CLOSED against the true limit rather than against a further partial sum: for an arbitrary shift n, Nat.even_or_odd's computed parity split (this batch) case-splits n = k+k (landing on the E side of alternatingBracket's paired conclusion) or n = succ(k+k) (landing on the O side), transported across the resulting index identity; converges_lower_bound_shift at shift s := m+m then closes E(m) <= L.

formal.statement: theorem CReal.alternatingLowerBound : ((x0 : ((x0 : AxNat) -> CReal)) -> ((x1 : ((x1 : AxNat) -> CReal.le CReal.zero (x0 x1))) -> ((x2 : ((x2 : AxNat) -> CReal.le (x0 (AxNat.succ x2)) (x0 x2))) -> ((x3 : CReal) -> ((x4 : CReal.Converges (CReal.sumRange (fun (x4 : AxNat) => CReal.mul (CReal.pow (CReal.neg CReal.one) x4) (x0 x4))) x3) -> ((x5 : AxNat) -> CReal.le (CReal.sumRange (fun (x6 : AxNat) => CReal.mul (CReal.pow (CReal.neg CReal.one) x6) (x0 x6)) (AxNat.add x5 x5)) x3))))))
